name: Shahab al-Din Yahya Suhrawardi
shortBio: Persian philosopher and founder of the Illuminationist school (Hikmat al-Ishraq); critiqued Avicennian Peripateticism and formulated the metaphysics of Light and Knowledge by Presence.
centralQuestion: Is fundamental reality an intensity gradient of self-manifesting primordial Light, known directly through unmediated presence rather than abstract concepts?

keyWorks.title: The Philosophy of Illumination (Hikmat al-Ishraq)
keyWorks.description: Foundational text of Illuminationism, replacing Peripatetic substance ontology with the gradation of Light and immediate luminous presence.

keyWorks.title: The Book of Intimations (Kitab al-Talwihat)
keyWorks.description: Detailed Peripatetic foundation and dialectical critique of Avicenna's epistemology.
